title: OneArrow
body:
# OneArrow – Event​
### By Exoryn Studios

OneArrow is a Minecraft event plugin where all players spawn randomly scattered around the arena. After spawning, a 15 second grace period begins. Once the grace period ends, a random player receives a bow and a single arrow.

### The goal is simple:

    if the player shoots and misses, the bow is transferred to another random player.
    If the player hits someone, they receive another arrow and can continue playing.


OneArrow is highly configurable, and almost nothing is hardcoded.


### Admin Information​

OneArrow includes a built in in game admin panel. You can use it to:

    Start an event
    View setup information
    Manage the event directly in game


### Event Phases​
Phase 1 – Joining Phase​

The joining phase can be started using:
/onearrow start
During this phase, players are able to join the event.


Phase 2 – Event Start​
An admin can force start the event using:
/onearrow forcestart
or by using the admin panel.

When the event starts, all players are teleported to the configured arena and the game begins.
